introHtml: Independent Trading Co is known for its streetwear-inspired silhouettes and heavy-weight fabrics, making it a favorite for brands that want their logo on apparel that employees actually wear. From the popular Nylon Anorak to classic fleece pullovers, these pieces hold up to screen printing and embroidery while maintaining a modern, relaxed fit. Whether you're outfitting a retail crew or a marketing event team, Independent Trading Co apparel gives your brand a casual, authentic look that stands out.
